synthesis:draft.headline: The POE50 forecast for SA1 for 2026-07-29 17:30 ACST (2026-07-29T08:00:00Z) was 2060.0 MW (evidence ev0538).

That run was issued at "2026-07-28T04:56:59Z" and available_at_utc = "2026-07-28T07:48:10Z" (get_forecast_runs output).

Actual operational demand for 2026-07-29T08:00:00Z (and the aligned half-hours in the review window) was not provably public by the as-of cutoff "2026-07-28T07:57:00Z", so no aligned forecast−actual comparison could be produced from the as-of data (get_actual_demand and compare_forecast_actual outputs).

possible_explanations.statement: Actual operational demand might have differed from the POE50 forecast (ev0538) because conditions such as weather or unplanned events changed between the forecast issuance and 2026-07-29T08:00:00Z; the POE50 definition is given in the AEMO data model [c2].

possible_explanations.statement: If actuals later show substantially lower or higher demand than 2060.0 MW (ev0538), the difference might be consistent with normal forecast uncertainty described by POE quantiles (see AEMO POE50 definition [c1]).
